title: Octanuclear {Ln(III)8} (Ln = Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho) Macrocyclic Complexes in a Cyclooctadiene-like Conformation: Manifestation of Slow Relaxation of Magnetization in the Dy(III) Derivative

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for 1–4: LH5 (0.071 g, 0.20 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (10 mL) and Ln(NO3)3·nH2O (0.40 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred for 0.5 h, then pivalic acid (0.041 g, 0.40 mmol) and triethylamine (0.1 mL, 0.70 mmol) were added and stirring continued for 4 h at room temperature, affording a yellow precipitate. The solid was filtered, washed with cold methanol (2 × 5 mL), dried, and dissolved in 1:1 v/v dichloromethane/methanol. X-ray quality crystals of 1 formed within a week by slow evaporation.
synthesis.time: 0.5 h then 4 h; crystals within a week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution; crystallization by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate filtered, washed with cold methanol (2 × 5 mL), dried, dissolved in 1:1 CH2Cl2/MeOH; X-ray quality crystals obtained by slow evaporation.

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of 1 shows weak antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling through phenoxo/alkoxo/pivalato bridges. χMT is 63.16 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature and falls to 23.8 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K is sigmoidal at low field and nearly saturates at 55.35 NμB at 5 T. A crude dinuclear/molecular-field fit gave J = −0.19 cm−1, zJ′ = −0.1, g = 2.018. No slow relaxation of magnetization at zero dc field.

properties.summary: χMT of 2 is 96.9 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature (expected 94.6) and decreases to 51.7 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, consistent with weak antiferromagnetic Tb···Tb interactions plus ligand-field/Stark depopulation. Magnetization at 2 K/5 T is 40.1 NμB without saturation. Zero-field ac susceptibility shows no frequency dependence; a 1000 Oe dc field does not induce observable slow relaxation above 2 K.

properties.summary: χMT of 3 is 118.9 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature (expected 113.4) and 83.5 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, indicating weak antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions plus anisotropy/Stark effects. Magnetization at 2 K/5 T is 46 NμB without saturation. Zero-field ac data show no slow relaxation (fast QTM). Under 1000 Oe, 3 exhibits slow relaxation of magnetization without a χ″M maximum above 2 K up to 1400 Hz, suggesting possible SMM behavior below 2 K.
